# Getting Started

> St

art testing your MCP server in minutes

> [!NOTE]
>
> The upcoming SDK 10, CLI 6, and Vitest 0.3 releases require an MCPJam lo
gin or `sk_` API key for every eval, including BYOK runs with uploads disabled. These versions must ship after the backend run-sta

rt endpoint is deployed. Earlier versions keep their existing behavior.

## 1. Choose how to open Inspector

Every option belo

w opens the MCPJam Inspector. Pick one based on where your MCP server runs.

> [card] [Web](https://app.mcpjam.com)
>
> No ins

tall. HTTPS servers only. Share servers with your team.

> [card] [Terminal](https://docs.mcpjam.com/installation.md#terminal)

>
> `npx @mcpjam/inspector@latest`. Requires Node.js. HTTP/S and local STDIO.

> [card] [macOS](https://docs.mcpjam.com/install

ation.md#desktop-app)
>
> Desktop app (`.dmg`). No Node.js. HTTP/S and local STDIO.

> [card] [Windows](https://docs.mcpjam.co

m/installation.md#desktop-app)
>
> Desktop app (`.exe` installer). No Node.js. HTTP/S and local STDIO.

> [card] [Docker](http
s://docs.mcpjam.com/installation.md#docker)\n>\n> Pull from Docker Hub. HTTP/S, plus STDIO servers that run inside the container.\
n\n* **Your server has a public HTTPS URL**: any option works. The web app needs no install.\n* **Your server runs on `localhost`
or over STDIO**: use Terminal or the macOS or Windows desktop app. The web app can't reach it.\n* **You want Inspector isolated in
a container**: use Docker. Reach servers on your machine at `http://host.docker.internal:PORT`, and note that STDIO commands run
inside the container, not on your machine.\n\nSee [Installation](https://docs.mcpjam.com/installation.md#which-one-do-i-need) for

the full comparison.

## 2. Connect a server

On first launch, MCPJam shows a **Welcome** overlay that guides you through conn
ecting your first server. You can:\n\n* **Enter your own server** — paste an HTTPS URL (e.g. `https://your-server.example/mcp`) or
a STDIO command (Terminal, Desktop, and Docker only).\n* **Try the Excalidraw demo** — a hosted diagramming MCP app, no setup req
uired.\n\nAfter connecting, MCPJam shows the server name and tool count, then offers an **Open Playground** button that seeds the

chat with the prompt:

```
What can this server do?
```

Press **Send** to explore your server's tools. No API key, ngrok, o

r ChatGPT/Claude subscription needed.

> [!TIP]
>
> You should see your server show **Connected** and its tools listed in the

d. Earlier versions keep their existing behavior.

pector. Pick one based on where your MCP server runs.
